confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Fiji tourism pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and varies widely; July is high season. FX: the 15 Oct 2026 figure was taken from search-result snippets that say the RBA page lists it, and I did not open the RBA table. The 16 Oct figure (0.6947) came only from a third-party site, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Fiji's tourism-gateway pricing around Nadi and Denarau, with local restaurant and café prices benchmarked loosely against Suva. Hotel anchors reflect resort-adjacent tourist demand in July. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
